gpuPolicy.firstPass: Run ready 1xH100 experiments first; promote only high-signal winners to 8xH100 record attempts.
gpuPolicy.batching: Queue is CPU-generated and GPU-consumed by one command so GPU time is spent only on selected runnable experiments. This queue is not capped; ticket/status lane inventory caps live in Fastest planning policy, not the GPU execution backlog.
gpuPolicy.quality: External Parameter Golf code remains subject to security and maintainability review; queueing optimizes idle GPU time, not quality gates.
